analytics.name: Analytic 1884
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session consistent with a program download to a field device from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, correlated with a device mode-change alarm transitioning to PROGRAM/STOP immediately preceding the transfer. Documented in Stuxnet (code/data block download to alter programmable logic controller behavior) and Triton (TriStation protocol program download to the Triconex Safety Instrumented System). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
